hook:
pick a pile.
what's coming in your love life before the year ends

piles.title: someone from the past checks in
piles.text: an old name shows up: a message, a like, a 'saw this and thought of you'. you get to decide if it's a reunion or just closure.

piles.title: a slow burn finally becomes obvious
piles.text: the person you've been reading signals from stops being subtle. expect a clear move before new year.

piles.title: you choose yourself, and it attracts the right one
piles.text: you stop shrinking to fit. that confidence is exactly what draws in someone steady. no chasing this time.

cta:
comment 1, 2 or 3
and come back in january to tell me
